table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	godown = (select godown.name from godown where godown.gcode=max(prdetail.gcode)),
	invcode = dbo.prledger.prinvcode,    
	date = dbo.prledger.date,    
	flatdisc = dbo.prledger.flatdisc, 
	salestax= dbo.prledger.salestax,       
	misccharges = dbo.prledger.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.prledger.discperc,  
	invgstperc1 = dbo.prledger.invgstperc1,  
	invtype = (select name from purchasetype where purchasetype.purtypecode=max(prledger.prtypecode)),
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	amount =  Sum ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty) * dbo.prdetail.prprice),    
	itemdiscpercvalue = Sum ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty ) * dbo.prdetail.prprice * (dbo.prdetail.discperc /100)),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Sum ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty )  * dbo.prdetail.prprice * (1 - dbo.prdetail.discperc /100)) * (dbo.prledger.discperc /100) , 
	totalsalestax =   Round (
	/*invoice level salestax*/Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty ) * dbo.prdetail.prprice * (1 - dbo.prdetail.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
								 * ( 1 - dbo.prledger.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - dbo.prledger.flatdisc ) * dbo.prledger.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 )
	/*items salestax*/	 + Sum (Round ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty + dbo.prdetail.bonusqty) * dbo.prdetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( (dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty) * dbo.prdetail.prprice * (1 - dbo.prdetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.prdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )						 
								 , ISNULL((SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundpurinvon')), 0)),
	accountfor = dbo.prledger.accountfor,
	posted=dbo.prledger.posted,
	purinvno=max(prledger.purchaseinvno)
FROM 
	dbo.prledger,    
	dbo.prdetail,    
	dbo.accounts   	
WHERE 
	( dbo.prledger.prinvcode = dbo.prdetail.prinvcode ) and  
	( dbo.prledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
	( dbo.prledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            
GROUP BY 
	dbo.accounts.name,   
	dbo.prledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.prledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.prledger.date,   
	dbo.prledger.prinvcode,   
	dbo.prledger.discperc,  
	dbo.prledger.invgstperc1 ,
	dbo.prledger.salestax, 
	dbo.prledger.prcatcode,
	dbo.prledger.accountfor,
	dbo.prledger.posted
table.sort: godown A, invcode A, purledger_date A

objects.name: c_totalnettotal
objects.expression: Sum( Round ( amount  - itemdiscpercvalue - invdiscpercvalue  -  flatdisc   +   misccharges +  salestax , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))  + totalsalestax for all)

objects.name: c_sum_grossamt
objects.expression: sum(amount  - itemdiscpercvalue - invdiscpercvalue  -  flatdisc for all)

objects.name: netamount
objects.expression: Round ( amount  - itemdiscpercvalue - invdiscpercvalue  -  flatdisc   +   misccharges +  salestax , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))  + totalsalestax

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: Sum( Round ( amount  - itemdiscpercvalue - invdiscpercvalue  -  flatdisc   +   misccharges +  salestax , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))  + totalsalestax for group 1)

objects.name: compute_5
objects.expression: sum(amount  - itemdiscpercvalue - invdiscpercvalue  -  flatdisc for group 1)
